nodes.text:
🚨BREAKING: First alleged case of HMPV detected in Assam.

The victim is a 10-month-old infant admitted at Dibrugarh’s Assam Medical College Hospital (AMCH).

The Regional Medical Research Centre confirmed about the case.

The infant has been isolated and given treatment.
